**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 78 **Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225) **Prerequisites** [Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486); wererat --- Your bites carry a cursed infection. When you hit and deal damage to a creature with a jaws Strike while in hybrid or rat shape, the creature is cursed until the start of your next turn. Whenever they regain Hit Points during that time, they must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. **Success** The creature regains Hit Points normally.
**Failure** The creature regains half the normal Hit Points.
**Critical Failure** The creature regains no Hit Points.
